covered.instructions: A writer proposes `idea`. Does the published page (`existing_title`, `existing_summary`) already answer the same reader question? Compare the questions each answers, not the wording of the titles.

criteria.same_question: The page already answers the question the idea would answer; writing it would compete with the page.
criteria.overlaps: The page covers part of it; the idea could be a section of that page or a clearly narrower angle.
criteria.different: The two answer different reader questions, even if the titles sound alike.
criteria.unclear: The summary is too thin to tell.
